'''John Hyland''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd, +6 +74 (Light) at [[June 2000 Nashville tournament]] on 14 June 2000, according to Josh Koziura's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d896">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-15-nashville-tn-6-14-00-anthology-tourneyd896/ nashville-tn-6-14-00-anthology-tourney], DeckTech (Josh "Blue1138" Koziura, 15 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-15-nashville-tn-6-14-00-anthology-tourneyd896/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
